x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"inspection_template_item\":{\"name\":\"string\",\"details\":\"string\",\"response_set_id\":0,\"type\":\"string\"}}"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "application/json"
    }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/inspection_templates/1/items/%7Bid%7D", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
